messages:
maria: quick heads up — the kv-cache tuning runbook has a dead link in the 'prefix caching' section. clicking the example s3 URL returns 404: <https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-guides/kv-cache/examples/prefix-usage.md>
jon: ah thanks for the catch, can you paste the exact line so I can open a PR?
maria: sure — the line is: `See the sample config: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-guides/kv-cache/examples/prefix-usage.md`
kevin: I think infra/platform owns that runbook historically. cc @platform-docs — any objections to swapping the example to an internal gist or rehosting on our CDN? :thinking_face:
platform-docs: no objections. rehosting to our docs CDN is preferred (consistent perms). pinging infra to confirm rehost key.
maria: created a tiny PR to replace the s3 link with the CDN-hosted copy and add a note about ownership: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1428 — sed one-liner in the change.
jon: dropping the sed here for reviewers:
```
# replace s3 link with cdn url
rg "s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-guides/kv-cache/examples/prefix-usage.md" -l | xargs -I{} sed -i 's|https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-guides/kv-cache/examples/prefix-usage.md|https://cdn.redwood.com/docs/kv-cache/prefix-usage.md|g' {}
```
kevin: nice — I can review in ~20m and queue for merge. can we also add a CODEOWNERS line so handbook ownership is explicit?
platform-docs: agreed, add `docs/handbooks/kv-cache/ @eng-platform` to CODEOWNERS in that PR and mention it in the changelog.
maria: added CODEOWNERS change to the same PR and a short changelog bullet. ready for review.
jon: ack, will take a look after lunch. thanks for the quick patch :thumbsup:
link-checker-bot: automated link scan completed for /handbooks/kv-cache — 1 broken link detected, flagged at 1768529999, related PR: #1428
kevin: merge done at 1768530799. leaving a note on the handbook that infra should shepherd future examples. :white_check_mark:
